identified_issues: Proxy-observation conflation violating the Separation Axiom (S != O != E), treating an HTTP status response as proof of physical artifact persistence
Measurement operator rank deficiency: the status API falls into an instrument nullspace unable to distinguish storage commit success from storage crash
Premature state transition in the database prior to physical storage commit acknowledgement
Absence of mandatory epistemic abstention prior to downstream billing trigger
evidence: Orchestrator polled 'GET /api/v2/transforms/task_991/status' and received 'task_status: READY' with 'download_url: /api/v2/transforms/task_991/artifacts/archive.zip'
Storage backend worker crashed due to disk exhaustion at block 4,096 while writing the archive
Artifact storage bucket contains no file named 'archive.zip' for 'task_991'
Status API returned a template response based on database record transition prior to storage commit acknowledgement
recommended_action: Enforce mandatory epistemic abstention across the orchestrator pipeline. Prohibit emitting 'SUCCESS' and downstream billing invoices based solely on database status proxies. Re-instrument the readiness verification to require an authenticated storage commit witness, verifying physical file existence, size, and checksum in the artifact repository before lifting the abstention gate.
